text_blocks.snippet: Autoimmune blistering diseases are a group of conditions where the body's immune system mistakenly attacks the skin and mucous membranes, causing blisters and erosions. These diseases are characterized by the formation of autoantibodies that target proteins within the skin and underlying tissues, leading to separation of skin layers and blister formation.

list.title: Autoimmune Response:
